children: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised the Placement Agents on the qualified institutions placement (“
”) of Aegis Logistics Limited, aggregating to INR 3,500 crore.

J.P. Morgan India Private Limited, HSBC Securities and Capital Markets (India) Private Limited, Jefferies India Private Limited, JM Financial Limited, BNP Paribas, CLSA India Private Limited and DAM Capital Advisors Limited acted as Placement Agents to the QIP.
Arjun Badola, Abhinav Singh Chauhan, Shvabh Chakarwarti, Alok Antony, Prishni Chakraborty, Sajal Soni
provided strategic guidance on the transaction.
